Frequently Asked Questions About AI Copywriter

Everything you need to know about AI writer and copy AI

Will AI copywriter replace human copywriters?

AI writer won't replace creative seniors, but excels at content marketing, SEO, product descriptions and blog articles. It's the perfect tool for copywriters - creates a first draft that you then polish.

What copywriting techniques does AI writer know?

Our AI copywriter knows classic techniques: AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action), PAS (Problem, Agitate, Solution), storytelling, call-to-action, power words, emotional triggers, benefit-driven writing and SEO copywriting.

Does copy AI only write in English?

No! AI writer creates texts in 8 languages: English, Polish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Ukrainian and Russian. Each text sounds like written by a native speaker.

Are AI copywriter texts unique?

Yes! AI writer never copies content from sources. It analyzes information and creates fully original text in its own words. You can check uniqueness in any plagiarism checker - it will be 100%.

How much does AI copywriter cost vs traditional copywriter?

Traditional copywriter: $15-30 per 1000 characters. AI copywriter Smart-Copy: $1.08 per 1000 characters. That's 12-25x cheaper! 10-page article: copywriter $150-250, copy AI ~$10.

Can I edit texts generated by AI writer?

Of course! After generation you have access to WYSIWYG editor - edit text like in Word. Add your insights, change tone, polish details. AI copywriter is a starting point, not the end.
